capabilities: Upload pasted and dropped images via PicGo, PicList, or PicGo-Core
Relay Markdown network images by downloading, re-uploading, and replacing URLs
Auto-process network images in Obsidian Web Clipper notes in a watched folder
Upload all local images in a note or picked files via commands
Skip already-relayed hosts and blacklist network domains
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop only, and PicGo/PicList must be running in app server mode.
intentEvidence: based on obsidian-image-auto-upload-plugin and keeps compatibility with PicGo/PicList workflows while adding the Pro features
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images as local vault files, so users need an external pipeline to host images and rewrite note links to hosted URLs.

relations.evidence: This project is based on obsidian-image-auto-upload-plugin
uploading images through PicGo, PicList, or PicGo-Core
